ratios.quote: During the Covenant Relief Period, the consolidated leverage ratio was increased to 4.00 X through December 31, 2025.

parsed.notes: The only number given is the relief-period maximum leverage of 4.00x, which applied through December 31, 2025 under the Third Amendment. No actual ratio is disclosed for that date. The filing names a consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio covenant but gives no numeric limit or actual value for it. It says only that the company was in compliance at September 30, 2026. Covenant limits that apply after the relief period are not stated, and the Fifth Amendment text is truncated. The Consolidated Coverage Ratio only sets the pricing grid, so it is excluded.
